_comment: Audit trail of every keyword research run. One entry per run — used to debug queue state and verify deduplication history.

runs.notes: First manual run. Competitor identification returned empty — domain too new/small for Ahrefs organic competitor tracking. 'free seating chart template' dropped at dedup check — already a secondary keyword of published article wedding-seating-chart-template.

Competitor identification already done (skipped Step 1). Parent-topic dedup (Check F) dropped 4 candidates with no existing queue entry to attach as cluster siblings: 'wedding place cards ideas', 'wedding name place cards', and 'table place cards' (parent_topic 'wedding place cards', already a published primary keyword), and 'seating chart examples' (parent_topic 'wedding seating chart ideas', also already published). Of the 10 remaining after Check F, 2 were dropped on editorial review despite passing mechanical guardrails: 'free seating chart maker for teachers' (parent_topic 'classroom desk arrangement generator' — genuinely a K-12 classroom-seating query surfaced via the shared 'seating chart maker' seed term, not a wedding intent, and not caught by the exclusion list's literal 'school' substring check), and 'how to make a seating chart' (near-duplicate of the already-published 'how-to-make-a-wedding-seating-chart' article — differs only by omitting the word 'wedding' and would cannibalize that page rather than target a distinct query). Net 8 keywords added to queue: kw-007 through kw-014.
